headline: The Construction Foreman Master 20
threshold: By Lesson 20, you can train a new worker and have them teach a task back, explain a hidden problem or substitution to an owner, refuse an unsafe request, talk through an incident or near miss without blame, and write the day's report in Spanish.

lessons.title: Why Shores Stay Until the Engineer Releases Them
lessons.objective: Explain step by step why the shores stay until the engineer releases them, and have the new hire explain it back.

words.note: Plural los puntales. Some crews also say el pie derecho.
For a woman: la ingeniera estructural. On this job, the engineer of record.
Informal way to say approval or sign-off.
The weight of the slab itself, before any other load.
Common in Mexico; encofrado is also understood.
Verb: descimbrar (to strip the forms).
Mexican usage; verb colar. Vaciado is also common.

words.en: First the slab is poured, then it has to cure.
words.es: Primero se cuela la losa, luego tiene que curar.

words.en: The shores stay because the concrete can't hold yet.
words.es: Los puntales se quedan porque el concreto todavía no aguanta.

words.en: That's why we wait for the structural engineer's go-ahead.
words.es: Por eso esperamos el visto bueno del ingeniero estructural.

words.en: I get it, but every job has its own design.
words.es: Te entiendo, pero cada obra tiene su propio diseño.
words.note: Informal (tú), foreman to a crew member.

words.en: Nobody removes a shore without the engineer's approval.
words.es: Nadie quita un puntal sin la autorización del ingeniero.

words.en: The cylinder tests decide the timing, not us.
words.es: El tiempo lo deciden las pruebas de cilindros, no nosotros.

words.en: Now you tell me why we wait, in your own words.
words.es: Ahora dime tú por qué esperamos, con tus palabras.
words.note: Informal (tú).

words.en: If you have doubts, ask me first.
words.es: Si tienes dudas, primero me preguntas a mí.
words.note: Informal (tú).

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is Mateo Ríos, a new carpenter: explain step by step why the shores stay until the engineer releases them, using primero, luego, porque and por eso, answer his questions, then have him explain it back.

grammar.focus: Connectors for sequence and cause (primero se vacía, luego cura, porque el concreto todavía no aguanta, por eso esperamos)

examples.es: Primero se cuela la losa y luego se cura varios días.
examples.en: First the slab is poured, and then it cures for several days.

examples.es: El concreto todavía no aguanta su peso, por eso los puntales se quedan.
examples.en: The concrete can't carry its own weight yet; that's why the shores stay.

lessons.title: Rebar Chairs and Cover: How a Garage Slab Works
lessons.objective: Explain how rebar, chairs and concrete cover work together and why the crew follows the cover shown on the plan.

words.note: The concrete between the steel and the surface.

words.en: Here we use the cover the plan shows.
words.es: Aquí se usa el recubrimiento que dice el plano.

words.en: If the mat sits too low, water reaches the steel.
words.es: Si la parrilla queda muy baja, el agua llega al acero.

words.en: The chairs keep the rebar at the right height.
words.es: Las silletas mantienen la varilla a la altura correcta.

words.en: Let's check the structural sheet together.
words.es: Vamos a revisar la hoja estructural juntos.

words.en: Your last job had a different design; here this plan rules.
words.es: Tu última obra tenía otro diseño; aquí manda este plano.
words.note: Informal (tú), foreman to an apprentice.

words.en: Before the pour, the cover is measured at several points.
words.es: Antes de colar, se mide el recubrimiento en varios puntos.

words.en: If a chair is broken, it gets replaced before the pour.
words.es: Si una silleta está rota, se cambia antes de colar.

words.en: Can you explain to me why we use chairs?
words.es: ¿Me explicas por qué se usan silletas?
words.note: Informal (tú); use it to start the teach-back.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is Lucía Ferrer, an apprentice: explain how chairs, rebar and cover work together on the garage deck using impersonal se and si + present, check the structural sheet with her, and have her explain it back.

grammar.focus: Impersonal se; si + present for general truths (si el acero toca la tierra, se oxida; aquí se usa lo que dice el plano)

examples.es: Si la sal llega al acero, se corroe más rápido.
examples.en: If salt reaches the steel, it corrodes faster.

examples.es: En esta losa se usa el recubrimiento que indica la hoja estructural.
examples.en: On this slab, the cover shown on the structural sheet is used.

lessons.title: Teaching a New Laborer to Inspect a Harness
lessons.objective: Train a new laborer to inspect a harness and lanyard step by step, then correct their teach-back.

words.note: Plural los arneses.
Some crews say la eslinga for the lanyard.
Always la persona, even for a man.

words.en: Check all of it before you put it on.
words.note: Informal (tú); the pronoun attaches to the infinitive: ponértelo.

words.en: Don't use it if it has cuts or loose stitching.
words.es: No lo uses si tiene cortes o costuras sueltas.

words.en: If it's damaged, hand it to me and I'll give you another one.
words.es: Si está dañado, entrégamelo y te doy otro.

words.en: Tighten your leg straps so they're snug.
words.es: Ajústate las correas de las piernas, que queden firmes.

words.en: You missed checking the label and the inspection tag.
words.es: Te faltó revisar la etiqueta y la tarjeta de inspección.

words.en: Show me the label and read me the date.
words.es: Muéstrame la etiqueta y léeme la fecha.

words.en: Clip it only to an approved anchor point.
words.es: Engánchalo solo a un punto de anclaje aprobado.

words.en: Very good, now you explain it to me from the start.
words.es: Muy bien, ahora explícamelo tú desde el principio.
words.note: Informal (tú).

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is Joaquín Bernal, a new laborer: train him to inspect his harness and lanyard step by step with commands like revísalo, póntelo and no lo uses si tiene cortes, then listen to his teach-back and correct it.

grammar.focus: Commands with object pronouns (revísalo, póntelo, no lo uses si tiene cortes, entrégamelo)

examples.es: Ábrelo y suéltalo; el seguro debe cerrar solo.
examples.en: Open it and let go; the gate must close on its own.

examples.es: Si la tarjeta está vencida, no te lo pongas; dámelo.
examples.en: If the tag is expired, don't put it on; give it to me.

lessons.title: Read the Grout Data Sheet Before Mixing
lessons.objective: Read a grout data sheet with a mason and explain the mixing and safety steps it requires before work starts.

words.note: Grout is standard job usage; you will also hear mortero sin contracción.
El agua takes el but is feminine: el agua fría.

words.en: Before mixing, we have to read the whole data sheet.
words.es: Antes de mezclar, hay que leer la hoja técnica completa.

words.en: We use the water per bag that the data sheet gives.
words.es: Usamos el agua que indica la hoja técnica por saco.

words.en: I know you add more water, but here the sheet rules.
words.es: Sé que usted le echa más agua, pero aquí manda la hoja.
words.note: Formal (usted), respectful with a veteran mason.

words.en: You have to put on the respirator before opening the bags.
words.es: Hay que ponerse el respirador antes de abrir los sacos.

words.en: After placing it, it has to be kept moist per the data sheet.
words.es: Después de vaciarlo, hay que mantenerlo húmedo según la hoja técnica.

words.en: What does the sheet say about the ambient temperature?
words.es: ¿Qué dice la hoja sobre la temperatura ambiente?

words.en: If it comes out too thick, don't add water; call me.
words.es: Si queda muy espeso, no le agregue agua; llámeme.
words.note: Formal (usted) commands: agregue, llámeme.

words.en: Before starting, let's go over the working time together.
words.es: Antes de empezar, revisemos juntos el tiempo de trabajabilidad.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is Ernesto Salgado, a mason: read the grout data sheet together and explain the mixing and safety steps it requires before work starts, using antes de + infinitive, después de + infinitive and hay que.

grammar.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que (antes de mezclar hay que leer la hoja; después de echarlo, hay que curarlo como dice el fabricante)

examples.es: Antes de abrir el saco, hay que ponerse el respirador y los lentes.
examples.en: Before opening the bag, you have to put on the respirator and safety glasses.

examples.es: Después de mezclar el tiempo que indica la hoja, hay que vaciarlo de inmediato.
examples.en: After mixing for the time the sheet gives, it has to be placed right away.

lessons.title: Old Septic Tank Under the New Footing
lessons.objective: Tell the homeowner what the crew found, what it means for the footing, and propose options for a change order.

words.note: Many crews also say el tanque séptico.
In the US, the county health department usually handles old septic tanks.

words.en: When we were digging this morning, Pablo found an old septic tank.
words.es: Cuando excavábamos esta mañana, Pablo encontró una fosa séptica vieja.

words.en: The tank was right where the new footing goes.
words.es: La fosa estaba justo donde va la zapata nueva.

words.en: Nobody saw it before because it wasn't in the records.
words.es: Nadie la vio antes porque no aparecía en los registros.

words.en: We could remove it and backfill with compacted material, as the engineer specifies.
words.es: Podríamos sacarla y rellenar con material compactado, según indique el ingeniero.

words.en: Another option would be to move the footing, if the engineer approves it.
words.es: Otra opción sería mover la zapata, si el ingeniero lo aprueba.

words.en: I'll give you a written estimate for each option.
words.es: Le doy un presupuesto por escrito de cada opción.
words.note: Formal: usted, for the homeowner.

words.en: I understand your concern about the cost, Mrs. Montes.
words.es: Entiendo su preocupación por el costo, señora Montes.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Pablo, stop digging there until we check it.
words.es: Pablo, deja de excavar ahí hasta que revisemos.
words.note: Informal: tú, between coworkers.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is homeowner Gabriela Montes: explain what Pablo found while digging using the preterite and imperfect (cuando excavábamos, encontró), then propose change-order options with the conditional (podríamos, sería).

grammar.focus: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal (cuando excavábamos, Pablo encontró un tanque; podríamos pedirle al ingeniero otra ubicación)

examples.es: Cuando excavábamos para la zapata, Pablo encontró un tanque viejo.
examples.en: When we were digging for the footing, Pablo found an old tank.

examples.es: Podríamos pedirle al ingeniero otra ubicación para la zapata.
examples.en: We could ask the engineer for another location for the footing.

lessons.title: Back-Ordered Windows: Substitute or Wait?
lessons.objective: Compare waiting for the specified windows with a substitute and explain what each option will mean for the schedule.

words.note: Use la arquitecta for a woman.
Read the value on the manufacturer's label; never assume it matches.
The opening in the wall where the window goes.
Many crews also just say el flashing.

words.en: According to the supplier, the specified windows will take 6 more weeks.
words.es: Según el proveedor, las ventanas especificadas van a tardar 6 semanas más.

words.en: The substitute will arrive sooner, but we have to check if it complies.
words.es: El sustituto llegará antes, pero hay que revisar si cumple.

words.en: Without the architect's written approval, nothing gets installed.
words.es: Sin la aprobación por escrito del arquitecto, no se instala nada.

words.en: Andrés, can you send me the quote and the lead time?
words.es: Andrés, ¿me puede mandar la cotización y el plazo de entrega?
words.note: Formal: usted, for the supplier rep.

words.en: Elena, if we wait, the interior finishes will start later.
words.es: Elena, si esperamos, los acabados interiores van a empezar más tarde.
words.note: Informal: tú, with the project manager you work with daily.

words.en: We're going to send the substitution request to the architect today.
words.es: Vamos a mandar hoy la solicitud de sustitución al arquitecto.

words.en: Meanwhile, we're going to cover the openings with plastic.
words.es: Mientras tanto, vamos a tapar los vanos con plástico.

words.en: Does the substitute have the same U-factor as the specified one?
words.es: ¿El sustituto tiene el mismo factor U que el especificado?

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is project manager Elena Cruz: compare waiting for the specified windows with the substitute using the future and ir a (llegará, va a tardar) and comparisons (más que, tan… como), and say that any substitute needs the architect's written approval.

grammar.focus: Future and ir a; comparisons (va a tardar más que el otro, llegarán antes, no es tan bueno como el especificado)

examples.es: El modelo especificado va a tardar más que el sustituto.
examples.en: The specified model is going to take longer than the substitute.

examples.es: El sustituto llegará antes, pero no es tan bueno como el especificado.
examples.en: The substitute will arrive sooner, but it isn't as good as the specified one.

lessons.title: Insurance Adjuster After the Weekend Leak
lessons.objective: Tell an insurance adjuster what happened over the weekend and give clear quantities, times and locations.

words.note: Use el ajustador for a man.
Formal documents also say la reclamación.
Common Mexican term for a pipe coupling.
Área is feminine but takes el in the singular: el área, las áreas.
Loseta is the common Mexican word for floor tile.

words.en: On Saturday a coupling on the temporary line broke.
words.es: El sábado se rompió un cople de la línea temporal.

words.en: The guard shut the valve on Sunday at 6:10.
words.es: El guardia cerró la llave el domingo a las 6:10.

words.en: 24 sheets of drywall were damaged in the kitchen and dining room.
words.es: Se dañaron 24 hojas de tablaroca en la cocina y el comedor.

words.en: 9 boxes of tile that were on the floor also got wet.
words.es: También se mojaron 9 cajas de loseta que estaban en el piso.

words.en: I arrived at 7:30 and took photos of everything.
words.es: Yo llegué a las 7:30 y tomé fotos de todo.

words.en: Here is the guard's report with the exact times.
words.es: Aquí tiene el reporte del guardia con las horas exactas.
words.note: Formal: usted, for the adjuster.

words.en: Do you want me to send you the invoices for the damaged material?
words.es: ¿Quiere que le mande las facturas del material dañado?
words.note: Formal.

words.en: We set up 2 dehumidifiers so mold doesn't grow.
words.es: Pusimos 2 deshumidificadores para que no salga moho.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is insurance adjuster Silvia Navarro: tell her what happened over the weekend in the preterite (se rompió, cerró, se dañaron) and give exact times, quantities and locations using numbers.

grammar.focus: Preterite narration; numbers under pressure (el sábado se rompió la línea, el guardia la cerró a las seis, se dañaron veinticuatro hojas)

examples.es: El domingo el guardia vio el agua y me llamó a las 6:15.
examples.en: On Sunday the guard saw the water and called me at 6:15.

examples.es: El lunes a las 8:00 medimos la humedad en 3 paredes.
examples.en: On Monday at 8:00 we measured the moisture in 3 walls.

lessons.title: Saying No to Pulling the Guardrail for Speed
lessons.objective: Refuse an owner's rep's request to remove the guardrail, explain the risk and offer a safe way to keep the schedule.

words.note: Also la baranda; both are understood on US jobsites.
HVAC is standard jobsite usage, said letter by letter.
Mexican term for the worker who rigs slings and loads.
The person who gives the crane operator signals.

words.en: I'm sorry, Mr. Peña, but the guardrail doesn't come down.
words.es: Lo siento, señor Peña, pero el barandal no se quita.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: I don't recommend that they go up without fall protection.
words.es: No recomiendo que suban sin protección contra caídas.
words.note: Formal; subjunctive after no recomiendo que.

words.en: Guys, don't remove the guardrail; it stays where it is.
words.es: Muchachos, no quiten el barandal; se queda donde está.
words.note: Informal, to the crew: ustedes command.

words.en: I understand the rush, but I'm not going to put my people at risk.
words.es: Entiendo la prisa, pero no voy a arriesgar a mi gente.

words.en: I suggest we wait for the planned lift with the protection in place.
words.es: Le propongo esperar el izaje programado con la protección lista.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: If someone falls, the whole job shuts down.
words.es: Si alguien se cae, se para toda la obra.

words.en: While the crane gets here, we'll prepare the bases and connections.
words.es: Mientras llega la grúa, preparamos las bases y las conexiones.

words.en: Don't go near the edge without being tied off.
words.es: No se acerquen al borde sin estar enganchados.
words.note: To the crew: ustedes command.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is owner's rep Ricardo Peña: refuse his request to remove the guardrail, explain the fall risk with no recomiendo que + subjunctive and negative commands (no la quiten), and propose waiting for the planned lift.

grammar.focus: Negative commands; subjunctive after no recomiendo que (no la quiten; no recomiendo que suban sin protección)

examples.es: No la quiten; el barandal se queda hasta el izaje.
examples.en: Don't take it down; the guardrail stays until the lift.

examples.es: No recomiendo que trabajen cerca del borde sin el barandal.
examples.en: I don't recommend that they work near the edge without the guardrail.

lessons.title: Feedback to a Veteran Mason on Out-of-Plumb Block
lessons.objective: Give a veteran mason specific feedback on out-of-plumb block and agree on what you want to see tomorrow.

words.note: El block is standard US jobsite Spanish for concrete block. You will also hear el bloque.
Masons also say está desplomado.
Short for la cuchara de albañil.

words.en: Rogelio, the corner is almost 1 inch out of plumb.
words.es: Rogelio, la esquina está fuera de plomo casi 1 pulgada.

words.en: I recommend you check plumb on every course.
words.es: Te recomiendo que revises el plomo en cada hilada.
words.note: Informal (tú), normal between coworkers on site.

words.en: This isn't about blaming Kevin; you're the one running the wall.
words.es: No se trata de culpar a Kevin; el muro lo diriges tú.

words.en: I'd rather have Kevin work next to you and learn from you.
words.es: Prefiero que Kevin trabaje a tu lado y aprenda contigo.

words.en: We'd better take this section down before the mortar hardens.
words.es: Es mejor que quitemos este tramo antes de que endurezca el mortero.
words.note: Antes de que always takes the subjunctive.

words.en: Your work has always been good; that's why I'm telling you straight.
words.es: Tu trabajo siempre ha sido bueno; por eso te lo digo directo.

words.en: Kevin, I want you to tell me if you see anything out of plumb.
words.es: Kevin, quiero que me avises si ves algo fuera de plomo.
words.note: Informal (tú), speaking to the helper.

words.en: Tomorrow I want you to show me the corner before lunch.
words.es: Mañana quiero que me enseñes la esquina antes del almuerzo.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is Rogelio Durán, a veteran mason: give specific, respectful feedback on his out-of-plumb corner and agree on what you want to see tomorrow, using quiero que and te recomiendo que with the present subjunctive.

grammar.focus: Present subjunctive after wishes and recommendations (quiero que revises la esquina, te recomiendo que uses el nivel cada hilada)

examples.es: Quiero que revises la esquina con la plomada antes de seguir.
examples.en: I want you to check the corner with the plumb bob before you keep going.

examples.es: Te recomiendo que le enseñes a Kevin a revisar cada hilada.
examples.en: I recommend you teach Kevin to check every course.

lessons.title: Two Subs, One Ceiling: Settling the Space Fight
lessons.objective: Relay each sub lead's version, check the coordination drawing with both and agree on the install sequence.

words.note: Mexican usage. You will also hear el cielo falso.
This is the plumbers' word. You will also hear la pendiente.

words.en: the clash (two trades in one space)
Marisol said her tray was already marked on the drawing.
words.es: Marisol dijo que su bandeja ya estaba marcada en el plano.

words.en: Tomás explained to me that the drain line needed that elevation.
words.es: Tomás me explicó que la línea de drenaje necesitaba esa elevación.

words.en: Each of you told me something different; let's check the drawing together.
words.es: Cada uno me contó algo distinto; revisemos el plano juntos.

words.en: Marisol, what date was on the drawing you used?
words.es: Marisol, ¿qué fecha tenía el plano que usaste?
words.note: Informal (tú), from one lead to another on site.

words.en: Tomás, you said you already had the threaded rods in, right?
words.es: Tomás, dijiste que ya tenías las varillas roscadas puestas, ¿verdad?

words.en: Nobody was lying; each of you was working from a different drawing.
words.es: Nadie mentía; cada quien trabajaba con un plano diferente.

words.en: If the drawing confirms it, the drain goes in before the tray.
words.es: Si el plano lo confirma, el drenaje va antes que la bandeja.

words.en: I'm going to email the agreement to the general contractor.
words.es: Voy a mandarle el acuerdo por correo al contratista general.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI plays electrical lead Marisol Vega and plumbing lead Tomás Aguirre: relay each lead's version with reported speech (dijo que, me contó que + imperfect), check the coordination drawing with both, and agree on the install sequence.

grammar.focus: Reported speech; imperfect for background (Marisol dijo que el ducto ya estaba marcado; Tomás me contó que el plano no mostraba la bandeja)

examples.es: Marisol dijo que el ducto ya estaba marcado en el plano de coordinación.
examples.en: Marisol said the duct was already marked on the coordination drawing.

examples.es: Tomás me contó que su plano no mostraba la bandeja de cables.
examples.en: Tomás told me his drawing didn't show the cable tray.

lessons.title: Keeping a Tired Crew Going Before Hotel Opening
lessons.objective: Encourage a tired crew, make concrete commitments on breaks and help, and talk with a young laborer about staying.

words.note: On many US jobs people also say el overtime.

words.en: I know you're tired, and you're right.
words.es: Sé que están cansados, y tienen razón.
words.note: To the whole crew (ustedes).

words.en: Nobody will work on Sunday; you'll get your day off.
words.es: El domingo nadie trabajará; tendrán su día de descanso.

words.en: Tomorrow I'll bring 2 more people to help in the lobby.
words.es: Mañana traeré 2 personas más para ayudar en el lobby.

words.en: We're going to make it, and we're going to do it right.
words.es: Vamos a lograrlo, y lo vamos a hacer bien.

words.en: I trust you all; you've done excellent work.
words.es: Confío en ustedes; han hecho un trabajo excelente.

words.en: Fernanda, thanks for telling me; I'll talk to the manager today.
words.es: Fernanda, gracias por decírmelo; hablaré hoy con el gerente.
words.note: Informal (tú), from one lead to another.

words.en: Iván, why are you thinking about leaving?
words.es: Iván, ¿por qué estás pensando en irte?
words.note: Informal (tú). Ask it in private, not in front of the crew.

words.en: If you stay, I'll talk to the office about your training.
words.es: Si te quedas, hablaré con la oficina sobre tu capacitación.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is carpenter lead Fernanda Ruiz, then young laborer Iván Paredes: encourage the tired crew with concrete commitments in the future (tendrán, traeré), use vamos a lograrlo and confío en ustedes, and talk with Iván about staying.

grammar.focus: Future for commitments; encouragement register (mañana tendrán su descanso, traeré dos personas más, vamos a lograrlo, confío en ustedes)

examples.es: Esta semana nadie hará más de 10 horas al día.
examples.en: This week nobody will work more than 10 hours a day.

examples.es: Iván, el lunes empezarás a trabajar con Fernanda en carpintería.
examples.en: Iván, on Monday you'll start working with Fernanda in carpentry.

lessons.title: One Elevator Delay, Four Different Listeners
lessons.objective: Explain the same delay to a laborer, the owner, your superintendent and the inspector, choosing tú or usted.

words.note: Mexican and US usage. You will also hear el ascensor.
Use la inspectora for a woman and el inspector for a man.
Use la for a woman: la superintendente Diana Quiroga.

words.en: Beto, could you tell the others the elevator is still closed?
words.es: Beto, ¿podrías decirles a los demás que el elevador sigue cerrado?
words.note: Informal (tú). The conditional podrías softens the request.

words.en: Mr. Lozano, I'd like to explain why the inspection was moved.
words.es: Señor Lozano, quisiera explicarle por qué se movió la inspección.
words.note: Formal (usted), for the owner.

words.en: Would it be all right if I email you the new date today?
words.es: ¿Le parece si le mando la nueva fecha por correo hoy?
words.note: Formal (usted).

words.en: Diana, I'm letting you know the elevator inspection didn't happen today.
words.es: Diana, te aviso que la inspección del elevador no se hizo hoy.
words.note: Informal (tú), for a superintendent you work with closely.

words.en: Inspector Méndez, would it work for you to reschedule for Thursday?
words.es: Inspectora Méndez, ¿le parece bien reprogramar para el jueves?
words.note: Formal (usted). Use her title and last name.

words.en: Sorry for the trouble; what do you need us to have ready for the visit?
words.es: Disculpe la molestia; ¿qué necesita que tengamos listo para la visita?
words.note: Formal (usted).

words.en: Until we have the certificate, nobody uses the elevator.
words.es: Hasta que tengamos el certificado, nadie usa el elevador.

words.en: I understand the tenants' move-in depends on this, Mr. Lozano.
words.es: Entiendo que la mudanza de los inquilinos depende de esto, señor Lozano.
words.note: Formal (usted).

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI plays laborer Beto Salas, owner Arturo Lozano, superintendent Diana Quiroga and inspector Raquel Méndez: explain the missed elevator inspection to each, switching between tú and usted and using softeners like quisiera explicarle and ¿le parece si...?

grammar.focus: Usted / tú switching; softeners (quisiera explicarle, ¿le parece si...?, ¿podrías avisar a los demás?)

examples.es: Beto, ¿podrías cerrar la puerta del cuarto de máquinas?
examples.en: Beto, could you close the machine room door?

examples.es: Inspectora Méndez, ¿le parece si confirmamos la nueva fecha ahora?
examples.en: Inspector Méndez, would it be all right if we confirm the new date now?

lessons.title: Incident Report: Hand Injury at the Table Saw
lessons.objective: Say and write the timeline of a table-saw injury with times and facts only, without guessing the cause.

words.note: Common jobsite word in Mexican and US Spanish for the saw's safety guard.
Round saw blades are usually called el disco.
Everyday Mexican word for a cut on the body.
Use la testigo for a woman.
La gerente for a woman, el gerente for a man.

words.en: At 10:40, Samuel was cutting a board on the saw.
words.es: A las 10:40, Samuel cortaba una tabla en la sierra.
words.note: Imperfect (cortaba) sets the scene; preterite tells what happened next.

words.en: Right away, Rosa applied direct pressure with gauze from the first-aid kit.
words.es: Enseguida, Rosa le aplicó presión directa con gasas del botiquín.

words.en: While we were waiting, I turned off and unplugged the table saw.
words.es: Mientras esperábamos, apagué y desconecté la sierra de mesa.

words.en: A few minutes later, Mario took him to the clinic.
words.es: Unos minutos después, Mario lo llevó a la clínica.

words.en: I didn't see the cut; I got there a few seconds later.
words.es: Yo no vi el corte; llegué unos segundos después.

words.en: I don't know the cause; I'm only telling you what I saw.
words.es: No sé la causa; solo le digo lo que vi.
words.note: Formal (le) when speaking to the safety manager.

words.en: Patricia, I'll send you the photos and Rosa's statement today.
words.es: Patricia, le mando hoy las fotos y la declaración de Rosa.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Nobody uses the saw until the investigation is finished.
words.es: Nadie usa la sierra hasta que termine la investigación.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is safety manager Patricia León: walk her through the timeline of Samuel's table-saw injury in the past tense with time markers like a las 10:40, enseguida, unos minutos después and mientras esperábamos, giving facts only, no guesses.

grammar.focus: Past narration with time markers (a las diez y cuarenta, enseguida, unos minutos después, mientras esperábamos)

examples.es: A las 10:40 Samuel gritó y enseguida paramos la sierra.
examples.en: At 10:40 Samuel shouted and we stopped the saw right away.

examples.es: Mientras esperábamos a Patricia, Rosa le mantenía presión en la mano.
examples.en: While we were waiting for Patricia, Rosa kept pressure on his hand.

lessons.title: Near Miss: The Rebar Bundle That Slipped
lessons.objective: Talk through a near miss with the rigger and the laborer without blame and agree on what changes in the next lift.

words.note: Common Mexican rigging word for a wire rope or synthetic choker.
The rope used to control a load from a safe distance.
Mexican word for the timbers set under a load.

words.en: The bundle almost fell on you, Nicolás.
words.es: Por poco te cae el bulto, Nicolás.
words.note: Informal, to a coworker. Por poco takes the present tense here but means 'almost' in the past.

words.en: It could have been serious; that's why we're talking about it.
words.es: Podría haber sido grave; por eso lo estamos hablando.

words.en: We're not looking for someone to blame; we're looking for what to change.
words.es: Aquí no buscamos culpables; buscamos qué cambiar.

words.en: Alma, tell me how you rigged the bundle before the lift.
words.es: Alma, cuéntame cómo amarraste el bulto antes del levante.
words.note: Informal.

words.en: Nicolás, why were you walking through that area at that moment?
words.es: Nicolás, ¿por qué caminabas por esa zona en ese momento?
words.note: Informal. Ask calmly to get facts, not to blame.

words.en: If it isn't balanced, we lower it and rig it again.
words.es: Si no está balanceada, la bajamos y la volvemos a amarrar.

words.en: On the next lift, nobody will walk under the suspended load.
words.es: En el próximo levante, nadie pasará debajo de la carga suspendida.

words.en: Thank you both for honestly telling me what happened.
words.es: Gracias a los dos por contarme lo que pasó con honestidad.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI plays rigger Alma Guzmán and laborer Nicolás Herrera: talk through the slipped rebar bundle without blame using por poco, casi and podría haber sido, and agree on changes for the next lift with si clauses.

grammar.focus: Casi, por poco, podría haber; si clauses (por poco le cae; podría haber sido grave; si el bulto se mueve, nadie estará debajo)

examples.es: Por poco le cae el bulto a Nicolás.
examples.en: The bundle almost fell on Nicolás.

examples.es: Si usamos la cuerda guía, nadie tendrá que estar cerca de la carga.
examples.en: If we use the tag line, nobody will have to be near the load.

lessons.title: Stop-Work Radio Call: Gas Smell at the Trench
lessons.objective: Stop work by radio, give short clear orders to clear the area and call emergency services and the gas utility.

words.note: In Mexico the device is el radio.
La guardia for a woman, el guardia for a man.

words.en: Stop everything and get away from the trench now!
words.es: ¡Paren todo y aléjense de la zanja ahora!
words.note: Plural ustedes commands to the whole crew.

words.en: Raúl, shut off the machine if it's safe and walk away.
words.es: Raúl, apaga la máquina si es seguro y aléjate caminando.
words.note: Informal, to one coworker.

words.en: Nobody light cigarettes or start engines.
words.es: Que nadie prenda cigarros ni arranque motores.

words.en: I'm calling to report a gas smell at a construction site.
words.es: Llamo para reportar un olor a gas en una obra.
words.note: Formal phone opening for 911 or the gas company.

words.en: Our excavator hit something and it smells like gas; there's a school nearby.
words.es: Nuestra excavadora golpeó algo y huele a gas; hay una escuela cerca.

words.en: How soon will your emergency crew get here?
words.es: ¿En cuánto tiempo llegará su equipo de emergencia?
words.note: Formal (su), to the gas company.

words.en: Ma'am, please don't come closer; there may be a gas leak.
words.es: Señora, por favor no se acerque; hay una posible fuga de gas.
words.note: Formal usted command to a member of the public.

words.en: If anyone crosses the tape, I'll stop them.
words.es: Si alguien cruza la cinta, yo lo pararé.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is excavator operator Raúl Medina on the radio: stop work with short ustedes commands like ¡Paren todo! and ¡Aléjense de la zanja!, then call 911 and the gas company, using si + present → future for your next steps.

grammar.focus: Si + present → future; short radio or phone commands (si alguien se acerca, lo pararé; ¡Paren todo! ¡Aléjense de la zanja!)

examples.es: Si los bomberos llegan, les daré la ubicación exacta de la zanja.
examples.en: If the firefighters arrive, I'll give them the exact location of the trench.

examples.es: Si el viento cambia, moveremos el punto de reunión.
examples.en: If the wind changes, we'll move the assembly point.

lessons.title: Safety Compliance Officer Walks the Scaffold
lessons.objective: Walk a safety compliance officer through scaffold inspections and records using formal, precise language.

words.note: La oficial for a woman; address her formally as oficial Carrillo.
Scaffold tag for 'safe to use'; tag colors follow the company's safety plan.
Common Mexican jobsite word; la andamiera for a woman.

words.en: Under our safety plan, it's checked before every shift.
words.es: Según nuestro plan de seguridad, se revisa antes de cada turno.

words.en: The results are written in the log and on the tag.
words.es: Los resultados se anotan en la bitácora y en la tarjeta.

words.en: Here is this month's inspection log, Officer Carrillo.
words.es: Aquí tiene la bitácora de inspecciones de este mes, oficial Carrillo.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Would you like to see the scaffold erectors' training certificates?
words.es: ¿Desea ver los certificados de capacitación de los andamieros?
words.note: Formal; desea is more polite than quiere.

words.en: You're right; this tag is missing the signature.
words.es: Tiene razón; a esta tarjeta le falta la firma.
words.note: Formal. Admit it plainly; don't make excuses.

words.en: Nobody goes up until the competent person checks and signs it.
words.es: Nadie sube hasta que la persona competente lo revise y firme.

words.en: The corrective action is documented today, and I'll email it to you.
words.es: La acción correctiva se documenta hoy y se la envío por correo.
words.note: Formal; se la = it to you.

words.en: Guys, don't go up on this section until further notice.
words.es: Muchachos, no suban a este tramo hasta nuevo aviso.
words.note: Informal, plural command to the crew.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is compliance officer Inés Carrillo: walk her along the north-face scaffold and explain who inspects it, how often your safety plan requires it and where the records are, using formal usted and passive se (se inspecciona, se registra).

grammar.focus: Formal register; passive se for procedures (el andamio se inspecciona cada turno según nuestro plan de seguridad; se registra en la tarjeta)

examples.es: El andamio se inspecciona cada turno según nuestro plan de seguridad.
examples.en: The scaffold is inspected every shift according to our safety plan.

examples.es: Cada inspección se registra en la tarjeta y se firma.
examples.en: Each inspection is recorded on the tag and signed.

lessons.title: Daily Log After the Pump Truck No-Show
lessons.objective: Write the daily log in clear written Spanish: work done, lost hours and cause, who was notified and next steps.

words.note: Hours paid with no productive work; common in logs and billing.
The office that sends out the trucks; ask for the dispatcher by name.
Standard written-log heading; in speech people say lo que hicimos.

words.en: The pump truck was scheduled for 7:00 and did not arrive.
words.es: La bomba estaba programada para las 7:00 y no llegó.

words.en: Due to the missing pump truck, 4 hours of work were lost.
words.es: Debido a la falta de bomba, se perdieron 4 horas de trabajo.
words.note: Debido a + noun; debido a que + full clause.

words.en: It should be noted that dispatch was called 3 times.
words.es: Cabe señalar que se llamó al despacho 3 veces.
words.note: Written register only; in speech say: ojo, llamamos 3 veces.

words.en: However, the plant held the trucks before they left.
words.es: Sin embargo, la planta detuvo los camiones antes de que salieran.

words.en: In addition, the crew checked the formwork and cleaned the pour area.
words.es: Además, la cuadrilla revisó la cimbra y limpió el área de colado.

words.en: Therefore, the pour was rescheduled for tomorrow.
words.es: Por lo tanto, el colado se reprogramó para mañana.

words.en: Elena Cruz was notified by phone at 8:15.
words.es: Se notificó a Elena Cruz por teléfono a las 8:15.
words.note: Keep the personal a: notificar a + person.

words.en: Elena, I'm sending you the log so you can forward it to the owner.
words.es: Elena, le mando la bitácora para que la reenvíe al dueño.
words.note: Formal (usted) to the project manager.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is project manager Elena Cruz: read her your daily log on the pump truck no-show, covering work done, lost hours and cause, who was notified and next steps, using debido a, por lo tanto, sin embargo and cabe señalar que.

grammar.focus: Written register; report connectors (debido a, por lo tanto, además, sin embargo, cabe señalar que)

examples.es: Debido a que la bomba no llegó, la cuadrilla perdió la mañana.
examples.en: Because the pump truck didn't arrive, the crew lost the morning.

examples.es: Sin embargo, cabe señalar que la compañía de bombeo no avisó del retraso.
examples.en: However, it should be noted that the pump company gave no notice of the delay.

lessons.title: Inspection Moved: Calls, Texts and Voicemails
lessons.objective: Reschedule by phone, text the crew and leave clear voicemails using polite phone and text conventions.

words.note: Female scheduler: la programadora; a man is el programador.
Troca is standard US jobsite Spanish for a pickup or work truck.

words.en: This is Miguel Rojas, the foreman on the duplex job.
words.es: Habla Miguel Rojas, el capataz de la obra del dúplex.
words.note: Use habla + name to identify yourself on the phone.

words.en: Could you confirm the inspector's arrival window for me?
words.es: ¿Me podría confirmar el horario de llegada del inspector?
words.note: Formal; podría softens the request.

words.en: Would it be possible for the inspector to arrive before 10:00?
words.es: ¿Sería posible que el inspector llegue antes de las 10:00?
words.note: Sería posible que + subjunctive (llegue).

words.en: Could you give me the confirmation number, please?
words.es: ¿Me podría dar el número de confirmación, por favor?
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Team, the inspection moved to tomorrow, from 8 to 12.
words.es: Equipo, la inspección se movió a mañana, de 8 a 12.
words.note: Informal crew text: short, times in digits.

words.en: Óscar, it's Miguel; call me before you head out with the truck.
words.es: Óscar, habla Miguel; llámame antes de salir con la troca.
words.note: Informal (tú) voicemail between coworkers; say your name first.

words.en: Sorry, Óscar, I know you already loaded the truck.
words.es: Lo siento, Óscar, sé que ya cargaste la troca.
words.note: Informal (tú).

words.en: Thank you very much, Lorena; I'll look out for your email confirmation.
words.es: Muchas gracias, Lorena; quedo pendiente de su confirmación por correo.
words.note: Formal phone closing.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is city scheduler Lorena Ibarra, then drywall sub Óscar Fuentes: confirm the new inspection window, read your crew text aloud and call Óscar, using le llamo de parte de, ¿me podría confirmar...? and ¿sería posible...?

grammar.focus: Phone and text conventions; conditional politeness (le llamo de parte de..., ¿me podría confirmar la hora?, ¿sería posible pasar a la tarde?)

examples.es: Buenas tardes, le llamo de parte de Construcciones Rivera por la inspección.
examples.en: Good afternoon, I'm calling on behalf of Rivera Construction about the inspection.

examples.es: ¿Sería posible pasar la inspección a la tarde, entre la 1:00 y las 4:00?
examples.en: Would it be possible to move the inspection to the afternoon, between 1:00 and 4:00?

lessons.title: Turnover Walk: Warranty Limits at the Daycare
lessons.objective: Walk an owner through turnover, explain what the warranty covers and under which conditions, and handle requests.

words.note: Fisura is a very thin crack; grieta is a wider one.
Wood or metal backing inside the wall; many crews just say el blocking.
Mexican usage for plastic or metal wall anchors.

words.en: Hairline cracks are normal when the concrete shrinks.
words.es: Las fisuras finas son normales cuando el concreto se contrae.

words.en: According to the contract, the workmanship warranty is 1 year.
words.es: Según el contrato, la garantía de obra es de 1 año.
words.note: Always name the source: según el contrato. Periods vary by contract.

words.en: We'll repair it as long as the crack comes from a workmanship defect.
words.es: La reparamos siempre que la fisura sea por un defecto de obra.
words.note: Siempre que + subjunctive (sea) means as long as.

words.en: If the crack gets wider, let me know and we'll measure it.
words.es: Si la fisura se abre más, avíseme y la medimos.
words.note: Formal (usted) command: avíseme.

words.en: Don't hang the shelving until the engineer confirms the load.
words.es: No cuelgue los anaqueles hasta que el ingeniero confirme la carga.
words.note: Hasta que + subjunctive (confirme) for a future condition.

words.en: I would ask the project engineer to confirm it in writing.
words.es: Le pediría al ingeniero del proyecto que lo confirme por escrito.

words.en: If the wall is drilled without approval, the warranty might not cover it.
words.es: Si perforan el muro sin aprobación, la garantía podría no cubrirlo.

words.en: Here is the manual with the warranty exclusions.
words.es: Aquí tiene el manual con las exclusiones de la garantía.
words.note: Formal.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is daycare director Claudia Benítez: walk her through turnover, explain what the warranty covers with siempre que and a menos que, and explain who must confirm wall loads, using the conditional (revisaríamos, le pediría).

grammar.focus: Conditional; subjunctive in conditions (la garantía cubre eso siempre que no se modifique; lo revisaríamos a menos que el contrato diga otra cosa)

examples.es: La garantía cubre esas fisuras siempre que no se modifique el piso.
examples.en: The warranty covers those cracks as long as the floor isn't altered.

examples.es: Lo revisaríamos sin costo, a menos que el contrato diga otra cosa.
examples.en: We would check it at no cost, unless the contract says otherwise.

lessons.title: Capstone: A Hard Day on the Community Gym Job
lessons.objective: Lead a full day: train, solve a shortage, refuse a shortcut, handle a near miss, meet the inspector and report.

words.note: Female worker: la trabajadora; a man is el trabajador nuevo.
Mexican usage for the packing slip you sign on delivery.
Female inspector: la inspectora; a man is el inspector.

words.en: Lupita, watch how I do it and then you do it.
words.es: Lupita, fíjate cómo lo hago y luego hazlo tú.
words.note: Informal (tú) commands for training a new hire.

words.en: Gerardo, according to the delivery ticket, we're missing 12 joists.
words.es: Gerardo, según la remisión, nos faltan 12 viguetas.

words.en: Could you send me the missing ones today?
words.es: ¿Me podría mandar las que faltan hoy mismo?
words.note: Formal (usted) to the supplier.

words.en: Felipe, I'm not going to allow the perimeter protection to be removed.
words.es: Felipe, no voy a permitir que quiten la protección perimetral.
words.note: Permitir que + subjunctive (quiten).

words.en: The wrench fell from the second level, but it didn't hit anyone.
words.es: La llave cayó del segundo nivel, pero no le pegó a nadie.

words.en: Inspector Arce, would you like to start with the joist connections?
words.es: Inspectora Arce, ¿desea empezar por las conexiones de las viguetas?
words.note: Formal; use her title and last name.

words.en: Due to the short delivery, the roof will be finished on Friday.
words.es: Debido a la entrega incompleta, el techo se terminará el viernes.
words.note: Written report register.

words.en: It should be noted that the perimeter protection stayed in place all day.
words.es: Cabe señalar que la protección perimetral se mantuvo todo el día.

lessons.speaking: You are the foreman, and the AI is Lupita, Gerardo, Felipe and inspector Arce: coach Lupita with tú commands, request the missing joists, refuse the guardrail shortcut (no voy a permitir que...), review the near miss and report using debido a and sin embargo.

grammar.focus: Capstone: integrating the Master 20 grammar (connectors, commands, subjunctive, conditional, past narration, formal and written register)

examples.es: Debido al atraso, Felipe pidió quitar el barandal; sin embargo, no se lo permití.
examples.en: Because of the schedule slip, Felipe asked to remove the guardrail; however, I didn't allow it.

examples.es: Lupita, no te acerques al borde hasta que te enganches.
examples.en: Lupita, don't go near the edge until you clip in.
